{{Top}}
[[File:Mass_Shadow_Generator.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Mass Shadow Generator]]
{{Quote|What manner of creature would have birthed such a thing? Nothing human, to be sure.|[[Kreia]], to [[Bao-Dur]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mass Shadow Generator''' was a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] used during the [[Battle of Malachor V]].

==Capabilities==
{{Quote|There's a centuries-old device—a superweapon—called a mass shadow generator. It can make a gravity anomaly strong enough to destroy a whole planet.|[[Jonas Balkar]]|<ref name="TOR:R4A">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=operation|R-4 Anomaly}}</ref>}}
[[File:MalachorV.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The shattered remnants of [[Malachor V]]]]
The Mass Shadow Generator drew upon the natural [[Mass shadow/Legends|mass shadows]] generated by planetary bodies. At Malachor V, the [[Gravity/Legends|gravitation]] anomalies at work within the [[Malachor system/Legends|Malachor system]] allowed it to unleash catastrophic devastation upon anything within close proximity of the planet. The superweapon was designed to take advantage of the unique gravitational fields present at Malachor V, but it would later be speculated that the weapon could be modified to function within any [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. The Mass Shadow Generator was capable of gravely damaging or destroying any ships or space stations in orbit above the target world, but it also annihilated virtually everything upon the planet's surface.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref><ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />

==History==
{{Quote|I remember standing on the bridge with you and watching the destruction of the Republic&mdash;watching ships full of soldiers and Jedi burn and die. I remember the look you had when you turned to me. It was the longest you'd ever looked at me. You didn't say anything&mdash;just a nod. Events move quickly then, even in my dreams. Flashes, explosions, you&mdash;falling. I could feel the pain around me. And then the memory. The drifting hulks of the Mandalorian ships, the dead&mdash;allies, friends, strangers. And then the echo. Lingering. The sound I awaken to in my nightmares. Does anyone deserve the Mandalorians' fate? Even some of their conquered worlds fared better.|Bao-Dur, to [[Meetra Surik]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />}}
The Mass Shadow Generator was created by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] tech specialist [[Bao-Dur]], under orders from the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], in the year [[3960 BBY]]. The weapon was the centerpiece of a trap with which Revan hoped to bring about a conclusive end to the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Overseeing the device's use was [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Meetra Surik]] who would later come to be known as The Exile. Revan lured the Mandalorians to [[Malachor V]], and a massive fleet [[Battle of Malachor V|battle]] ensued in orbit. During the fighting, Surik commanded Bao-Dur to activate the secret weapon with a single, silent nod. Moments later, a significant portion of both fleets were suddenly drawn from orbit into a vast gravity vortex that was powerful enough to crush the countless ships into the planet's crust and fracture Malachor V to its very core.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />

[[File:Malchorlandscape.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Malachor V, transformed into a cluster of planetoids assaulted by tectonically-generated storms]]

During the event, Malachor V was turned into a broken cluster of planetoids that were only tenuously fused together by the gravitational anomalies present in the system. Orbiting the broken remains of the planet was the wreckage of countless Mandalorian and Republic warships. All that remained on the surface of the planet was a desolate graveyard echoing with the deaths of thousands of Jedi, Republic soldiers, and Mandalorians. It was littered with destroyed vessels and the only surviving inhabitants were vicious [[storm beast]]s.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />

In [[3951 BBY]], the Mass Shadow Generator was used a second and final time. During her campaign against the [[Sith Triumvirate]] during the [[First Jedi Purge]], Surik traveled to Malachor V in pursuit of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Kreia|Darth Traya]]. At the [[Trayus Academy]], she fought the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces occupying the planet and defeated both [[Darth Sion]] and Darth Traya in combat. Soon after, the Mass Shadow Generator was activated by [[Bao-Dur's remote]] and the sudden release of the gravity field [[Battle of Malachor|destroyed]] what was left of the planet.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />

Around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.1}}</ref> during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the Mass Shadow Generator was reconstructed in a nearby sector by an obscure Sith cult known as [[The Unmasked]]. The cybernetically modified leader of the cult, Lady [[Dominique]], attempted to unify her consciousness with the Mass Shadow Generator to control the superweapon. Before the Mass Shadow Generator was able to be re-weaponized, a strike team including the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] was able to [[Mission to the R-4 anomaly|stop]] the Unmasked and once again destroy the superweapon.<ref name="TOR:R4A" />

==Behind the scenes==
Though a non-canon outcome, [[G0-T0]] destroys the remote and the Mass Shadow Generator is not activated a second time, if the player is devoted to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].

Although ''Timeline 9: The Mandalorian Wars'' states that Revan, not Surik, was the one to activate the Generator, this is not necessarily a retcon, as the Timeline series is presented in-universe as history as the Jedi choose to describe it.
